unresolvedConflicts.subject: Green Meadow Sustainable Solutions
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The repository attributes Green Meadow to BCP Infrastructure Fund I, while Bernhard Capital Partners' official ESG report attributes it to BCP Fund II; the completed evidence does not establish whether that Fund II mandate qualifies as an infrastructure strategy.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Verify whether the BCP Fund II mandate holding Green Meadow qualifies as infrastructure before making any repository vehicle or scope correction.

notes: All six repository snapshot records were reconciled as primary holding matches; no repo-only records remain.
Cleco is retained as SIGNED_PENDING_INCOMING and PROPOSED_NEW because the Bernhard and Stonepeak acquisition was signed but remained pending.
The Cleco overlap with Stonepeak as co-acquirer and BCI and Macquarie Asset Management as members of the selling consortium was cross-referenced without merging manager tasks.
Green Meadow remains CLOSED_ACTIVE and NEEDS_REVIEW pending verification that its BCP Fund II mandate qualifies as infrastructure.
